modern: The safety of life is this: to examine everything all through, what it is in itself, what is its material, what its formal part; with all your soul to do justice and to speak the truth. What remains, except to enjoy life by joining one good thing to another so as not to leave even the smallest gaps between?

explained.summary: Living safely means examining everything thoroughly, seeing what it is, what it’s made of and what gives it its form, and then putting your whole heart into acting fairly and speaking truthfully. What’s left after that is to enjoy life by linking one good action to the next, with no gaps in between.
explained.today: A good day can be built from small things done well, one after another: an honest answer to a client, a patient bedtime story, a fair split of the chores. Marcus’s idea of enjoying life is stringing these together so closely that there’s no room for the bad.
